text: Acceptance evidence: isolated-cache sbt +test checkFormatting passes on Scala 3.3.8 and 3.8.4, 37/37 tests in each lane. Vertical fake-Slurm flow covers private inline staging, sbatch acceptance, pending squeue JSON, byte-cursor logs, sacct OOM diagnosis, focused scontrol, and scancel acknowledgement. Real fs2 subprocess tests prove simultaneous bounded stdout/stderr capture, environment allowlisting, timeout evidence, and process finalization; log laws prove WaitingForFile, truncation/identity invalidation, cancellation, and symlink confinement. Static audits find no shell construction, unbounded main-code reads, or CE/FS2 runtime types in core. Synthetic v0.0.43 fixture sha256 c11b2379a918dbc643ece110048682f47b8bf6dc3a8476679823a1b339911c9f and provenance explicitly make no support claim.
